description: This file defines the Feedback class, a data model representing customer feedback with properties such as ID, comments, rating, and order ID, along with constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Feedback
classes.description: A class to encapsulate feedback details including feedback ID, comments, rating, and associated order ID.

methods.name: Feedback
methods.description: Constructor to initialize Feedback objects with ID, comments, rating, and order ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns the comments associated with the feedback.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Returns the rating provided in the feedback.

methods.name: getOID
methods.description: Returns the order ID associated with the feedback.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets the comments for the feedback.

methods.name: setRating
methods.description: Sets the rating for the feedback.

methods.name: setOID
methods.description: Sets the order ID associated with the feedback.
